title: Horizon and Passage
author: Sable Delacroix
blurb: Ada Montrose, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
